title: eleições legislativas regionais na Madeira em 1976
summary: Madeira elected the first Legislative Assembly of its autonomous region on 27 June 1976, the same day as the Azores and as the presidential election. The Popular Democratic Party won a majority. The seat had been made three months earlier by the constitution, which gave both Atlantic archipelagos political autonomy — a statute, an elected assembly and a government of their own — rather than the district administration they had had under the Estado Novo. It is in the atlas as the beginning of a regional politics that has run on its own clock ever since, and which in Madeira produced the longest single tenure of the democratic period.
